title: The quarterly review: the chart that survives the question "so what?"

videos.script: Bia's first draft of the quarterly review had fourteen charts. {{fourteen}} Marta, the director of sales, looked at the one with story points going up and to the right, and asked one question. So what? {{sowhat}} Nobody could answer it. Points went up. Did any shop get anything sooner? {{sooner}} The chart went. So did twelve of the others. {{went}} What was left fits on one page. Work takes four days instead of twenty-three. Releases are four times as frequent, with no more failures. And one afternoon in September charged two hundred and twelve cards twice. {{left}} This lesson is about the quarterly review. Who reads it, what they decide, and the chart that survives the question. {{lesson}}
